nodes.title: Add a Reset slide control to remove all images from a slide
nodes.summary: In the Slide Data view, add a "Reset slide" action next to the "Add images" button that removes every image element that was added to the current slide, returning it to its original state so the user can start the image process over. The action asks the user to confirm before anything is removed, saves the reset slide back to the slideshow deck the same way other slide updates are saved, refreshes the viewer so the slide shows no images, stays on the same slide after saving, and reports success or failure to the user. It leaves all other slides and the slide's non-image elements untouched.

## Goal to plan
Goal: Add a Reset slide control to remove all images from a slide
Description: In the Slide Data view, add a "Reset slide" action next to the "Add images" button that removes every image element that was added to the current slide, returning it to its original state so the user can start the image process over. The action asks the user to confirm before anything is removed, saves the reset slide back to the slideshow deck the same way other slide updates are saved, refreshes the viewer so the slide shows no images, stays on the same slide after saving, and reports success or failure to the user. It leaves all other slides and the slide's non-image elements untouched.
Version: v1
